classified_targets.name: CODEX
classified_targets.install_text: Install this folder as the Codex plugin root. It contains `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` and `skills/`, and should be imported through the Codex local marketplace entry instead of copied to `~/.codex/skills/`.
notes: The repository includes `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` pointing at `./plugins/engineering-calculation-system` for local Codex plugin discovery.

A Codex plugin install should expose `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` plus `skills/engineering-calculation-system/SKILL.md`; raw `~/.codex/skills/engineering-calculation-system/` installs are legacy fallback only.

classified_targets.name: MiniMaxCode
classified_targets.install_text: For local MiniMax Code / Mavis installs, copy `skills/engineering-calculation-system/` to `%USERPROFILE%/.mavis/skills/engineering-calculation-system/`, then restart MiniMax Code or verify with `mavis skill list`. For sharing or marketplace-style import, publish the unzipped archive as a Github repository root and use Skills -> Create -> Import from Github. The repository skill entry is `skills/engineering-calculation-system/SKILL.md`.
notes: This package follows the MiniMax Skills repository layout: `skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md`.
Local user-skill install root observed on Windows MiniMax Code / Mavis builds: `%USERPROFILE%/.mavis/skills/`.
If `mavis skill list` reports a different `agent_skills_dir` or user skill root, copy the folder to that reported root instead.
For Github import, publish the unzipped archive contents as the repository root rather than uploading the zip file itself.

classified_targets.name: ZCode
classified_targets.install_text: Install this folder as a local ZCode marketplace source from Settings -> Plugins -> Discover -> +, then click Get on the Engineering Calculation System card and keep it enabled. If a previous cached copy is already installed but the skills are missing or still show as a single old entry, uninstall that plugin entry, refresh the marketplace, and click Get again so ZCode reads the current `.zcode-plugin/plugin.json` with `"skills": "skills"`. For manual filesystem staging, copy the folder to `~/.zcode/plugins/engineering-calculation-system-zcode/`, add that folder as a local marketplace source, refresh Settings -> Plugins, and use its bundled skills from the Plugin skills surface.
notes: ZCode plugin management is currently Beta; the plugin exposes the main `engineering-calculation-system` entry, three parent-layer entries, and lifecycle phase entries for router, 01-14, and 12a/12b/12c workflows.
The plugin manifest uses ZCode's native skill component declaration: `"skills": "skills"`; stale cached installs that still have `"skills": "./skills/"` should be uninstalled and installed again.
The plugin can be imported from a local path or Git/marketplace source; root `marketplace.json` points back to this plugin folder for path-based marketplace import.
Legacy user-skill install remains a fallback: copy `skills/engineering-calculation-system/` to `~/.zcode/skills/engineering-calculation-system/` if plugin import is unavailable.
For project-level behavior, place `AGENTS.md` in the ZCode workspace root; ZCode reads user `~/.zcode/AGENTS.md` first and workspace `AGENTS.md` as the primary project instruction source.

classified_targets.name: QODER
classified_targets.install_text: Upload this zip directly from QODER's Skills / Install Skill flow. This is the direct skill/resource entrypoint for lightweight routing. For full project work, install Qoder user-level resources once and also deploy the QODER Project package into each project root.
notes: This archive places SKILL.md at the zip root for QODER skill import compatibility.
Read qoder_quickstart.md first to run the Qoder Package Self-Check and decide whether the current install is direct skill, project overlay, or complete core package.
For web-complete generation, deploy the QODER Project package into the current project because it includes the core skill, templates, schemas, validator, project scaffold, and .qoder overlay.
Recommended deployment choice: user-level install once for reusable Qoder agents/skills/references, plus QODER Project once per production project.
If only this direct skill is installed, it is a lightweight entrypoint, not the complete project template.
Qoder Smart Agent mode should use `.qoder/agents/engineering-calc-system.md` as the supervisor and keep long references outside `.qoder/agents/`.
Multiple Qoder worker agents are packaged by the QODER Project archive, not by the direct Skill archive.

classified_targets.name: QODER Project
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into the root of the QODER project. This is the required package for full Qoder project capability; pair it with one user-level install when you want reusable agents and skills available globally.
notes: This directory already merges the core skill, shared adapter docs, and `.qoder/` files.
Recommended deployment choice: install Qoder user-level resources once for global discovery, then deploy this project package into every serious/production Qoder project.

Recommended Qoder architecture: `.qoder/agents/engineering-calc-system.md` is the Smart Agent supervisor; `.qoder/agents/engineering-calc-*.md` are delegated worker agents; `.qoder/skills/engineering-calc-system/` is the skill/resource layer; `.qoder/references/` stores long references so they are not listed as disabled agents.

Start new Qoder projects by reading `.qoder/skills/engineering-calc-system/qoder_quickstart.md`, then let the supervisor classify install shape, material state, delivery mode, lifecycle path, and gate status.
A single `python tools/build_release.py` run packages the full Qoder multi-agent program into the QODER Project archive.
From a source checkout, `python tools/install_qoder_user.py --build` syncs the packaged Qoder overlay into `QODER_HOME` or `~/.qoder` and verifies all worker agents.
Use `python tools/install_qoder_user.py --audit` to detect missing or redundant managed Qoder files, and `python tools/install_qoder_user.py --uninstall` to remove only this package's Qoder files.

classified_targets.name: Qoder CLI Plugin
classified_targets.install_text: Install this zip or directory through Qoder CLI plugin management. The zip root contains `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json`, complete core skill resources, Qoder-compatible supervisor/worker agents, references, and adapter docs.
notes: This is the official Qoder CLI plugin layout: `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json`, `skills/`, `agents/`, `references/`, `qoder.md`, `CONNECTORS.md`, and `README.md`.
The plugin includes the complete core package at `skills/engineering-calculation-system/` so Qoder CLI can use templates, schemas, validators, project scaffold, and shared lifecycle contracts.
The Qoder quickstart layer is preserved at `skills/engineering-calc-system/` for direct skill-style routing, but production work should route to the bundled complete core skill.
No external Connector is required by default; project-specific connectors should be authorized explicitly in the target Qoder CLI task.

classified_targets.name: QoderCN
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into the Qoder CN user resource directory, typically `~/.lingma/` for Qoder CN IDE custom Skills and Agents. This is the reusable user-level layer; deploy QoderCN Project into each serious/production project for full capability. You can also deploy from source with `python tools/install_qoder_user.py --product qodercn --build`.
notes: Recommended deployment choice: QoderCN user-level once for reusable agents/skills/references, plus QoderCN Project once per production project.
Alibaba Cloud Qoder CN docs describe user-level custom agents under `~/.lingma/agents/<agentName>.md` and user-level skills under `~/.lingma/skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md` for IDE use.
Qoder CN was formerly Tongyi Lingma; current IDE process/cache paths may still include `.qodercn`, while custom Skill/Agent resources remain compatible with the Lingma resource layout.
This package reuses the Qoder supervisor, worker agents, skill resources, and references without renaming internal agent IDs.

classified_targets.name: QoderCN Project
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into the root of the Qoder CN project. This is the required package for full Qoder CN project capability; pair it with one user-level install when you want reusable agents and skills available globally.
notes: This directory already merges the core skill, shared adapter docs, and `.lingma/` files.
Recommended deployment choice: install Qoder CN user-level resources once for global discovery, then deploy this project package into every serious/production Qoder CN project.
Qoder CN IDE custom agents are documented at `${project}/.lingma/agents/<agentName>.md`; project-level Skills are documented at `.lingma/skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md`.
Use `.lingma/agents/engineering-calc-system.md` as the supervisor and `.lingma/skills/engineering-calc-system/` as the skill/resource layer.

classified_targets.name: QoderCN CLI
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into the QoderCN CLI user's home directory, preserving both `.qoder-cn/` and `.qodercn/`. Skills go under `~/.qoder-cn/skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md`; custom agents go under `~/.qodercn/agents/<agentName>.md`.
notes: This package follows the QoderCN CLI split user-resource layout documented by Alibaba Cloud: user Skills under `~/.qoder-cn/skills/` and user Subagents under `~/.qodercn/agents/`.
It is a reusable user-level layer only. For source-backed production or `web-complete` work, also deploy QoderCN CLI Project into the project root.
Keep `.qodercn/references/` with `.qodercn/agents/` so agent-relative reference links continue to resolve.

classified_targets.name: QoderCN CLI Project
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into the root of the QoderCN CLI project. This package keeps project Skills under `.qoder/skills/` and project custom agents/references under `.qodercn/`, matching the documented QoderCN CLI split layout while also bundling the complete core package.
notes: This directory already merges the core skill, shared adapter docs, `.qoder/skills`, and `.qodercn/agents` files.
Recommended deployment choice: install QoderCN CLI user resources once for global discovery, then deploy this project package into every serious/production QoderCN CLI project.
Use `.qodercn/agents/engineering-calc-system.md` as the supervisor and `.qoder/skills/engineering-calc-system/` as the skill/resource layer.
Do not replace this package with the QoderCN IDE `.lingma` package; the CLI and IDE product lines use different documented resource paths.

classified_targets.name: QoderCN Cloud Agents
classified_targets.install_text: Upload this zip to QoderCN Cloud Agents as a custom Skill. The zip root contains `SKILL.md`, `reference.md`, `qoder_quickstart.md`, and `assets/`, which matches the Cloud Agents Skill upload model and stays below the documented 10 MB Skill zip limit.
notes: This is a Cloud Agents Skill upload package, not a local IDE/CLI project overlay.

After uploading, bind the returned Skill ID/version to the target Agent through the Cloud Agents API or UI. The bind API replaces the Agent `skills` list, so preserve any existing skills before updating.

This direct Skill remains a lightweight router. For production `web-complete` engineering software, the target project still needs the complete core package, templates, schemas, validator, and project scaffold.

classified_targets.name: QoderWorkCN
classified_targets.install_text: Upload this zip directly from QoderWork CN's Expert Kits flow: Extensions -> Expert Kits -> + Add -> Upload Kit. The zip root contains `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json`, complete core skill resources, QoderWork CN-native supervisor/worker agents, references, and adapter docs.
notes: This is the official QoderWork CN Plugin / Expert Kit layout: `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json`, `skills/`, `agents/`, `references/`, `qoder.md`, `CONNECTORS.md`, and `README.md`.
The kit includes the complete core package at `skills/engineering-calculation-system/` so QoderWork CN can use templates, schemas, validators, project scaffold, and shared lifecycle contracts.
The QoderWork CN quick-entry layer is generated at `skills/engineering-calc-system/` with native expert-kit paths and no legacy project-overlay instructions.
No external Connector is required by default; project-specific connectors should be authorized explicitly inside QoderWork CN.

classified_targets.name: WorkBuddy
classified_targets.install_text: Prepare this upload kit for Tencent WorkBuddy's Skills Marketplace / Expert Center import flow. The zip root contains `.qoder-plugin/plugin.json`, complete core skill resources, supervisor/worker agents, references, and adapter docs; if the WorkBuddy client labels the import flow differently, choose the generated zip from the custom skill or expert-kit upload entry.
notes: WorkBuddy is positioned as a Tencent AI Agent workbench with expert teams, a skills marketplace, customizable skills, MCP expansion, and Tencent office ecosystem connectivity.
This package keeps the official expert-kit upload structure so WorkBuddy can import the same complete lifecycle assets used by QoderWork CN.

Use the full core skill at `skills/engineering-calculation-system/` for web-complete engineering calculation delivery; the lightweight Qoder-compatible skill remains available at `skills/engineering-calc-system/`.
No external Connector is required by default; authorize project-specific connectors explicitly inside WorkBuddy.

classified_targets.name: TRAE
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into the root of the TRAE project.
notes: This directory already merges the core skill, shared adapter docs, and `.trae/` files.

classified_targets.name: OpenCode
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into the root of the OpenCode project.

classified_targets.name: AGENTS Generic
classified_targets.install_text: Copy the contents of this folder into an AGENTS.md-compatible project root.

classified_targets.name: DeepSeek Harness
classified_targets.install_text: Install this native Harness bundle with dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute folder>. Use dsh --profile web --dump-config to verify the composition layer, then restart the client.
notes: Uses the native Cordis skill provider and profile bundle manager. Does not overwrite profile settings, credentials, sessions, or unrelated plugins.
